cohort: 219 teenagers who gave birth at a public maternity between 1996 and 2012; 73 aged 13-15 years and 146 aged 16-17 years.
finding: Teenage girls aged 13-15 years have high perinatal risks, including prematurity and congenital malformations, but these risks do not appear to be higher than those of teenagers aged 16-17 years.
